pkgmetadata.longdescription: Fork of llama.cpp by JakeATX for the Qwen3.8 family: adaptive MTP drafting, SJ-KVaRN and TurboQuant KV-cache types, AI+ weight files and the Flash-Next mode, which keeps a ranked expert cache on the card and the remaining experts in system RAM. Installed under /opt/llamampere with ampere- prefixed symlinks in /usr/bin to coexist with sci-misc/llama-cpp.

use.flag: Serve and fetch over HTTPS with dev-libs/openssl
